title: Ansible Automation Engineer
description:
Senior Ansible Automation Engineer (Windows/Linux)

Location: Remote in LATAM – Brazil (Work primarily in local time zone with overlap across US, India, and UK teams)

Duration: 6 months (possible extensions)


Responsibilities

We are seeking a Senior Ansible Automation Engineer to support enterprise automation initiatives using Ansible Automation Platform (AAP) and Event Driven Ansible (EDA). This role focuses on enhancing and migrating automation use cases across Windows and Linux environments, with a strong emphasis on Windows.


Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain Ansible Playbooks, Workflows, and Event?Driven automations

Analyze and migrate existing Windows/Linux automation workflows into Ansible-based solutions

Automate operational tasks including patching, compliance, configuration, and observability

Integrate Ansible with enterprise tools such as ServiceNow, Splunk, VMware, and external databases (SQL/Oracle)

Build and maintain custom Ansible modules and collections (Python-based)

Collaborate with global, cross-functional teams and contribute to a backlog-driven automation model

Produce documentation and support knowledge transfer activities


Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Ansible Automation Platform (AAP)
  • Working knowledge of Event Driven Ansible (EDA)
  • Advanced Ansible Playbook development for Windows and Linux
  • Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, or Bash; strong YAML/JSON skills
  • Experience in integrating automations with APIs and external data sources
  • Familiarity with GitHub and CI/CD concepts

title: Chief Engineer (Process Safety)
description:
Our Client, a leading oil and gas engineering firm in Singapore, is seeking a highly experienced Chief Engineer (Process Safety) with 22+ years of expertise to join their team. AgileHRO will handle the Singapore Employment Pass sponsorship and relocation for the successful Brazilian candidate.


Important: This role is based in Singapore and requires relocation


Role Description

  • Independently develop/oversee design safety philosophy, HSE Plan, and specifications for fire protection systems (active and passive), HFE, etc.
  • Lead/participate in process hazard reviews and analysis, including HAZOP/HAZID/SIL studies, and be responsible for action close-outs.
  • Lead/chair the HAZOP/HAZID/SIL workshops, if required.
  • Review third-party safety studies, including FERA, dispersion analysis, EERA, ESSA, dropped objects study, QRA studies, etc. (not limited to). Capable of independently carrying out similar safety studies, as required.
  • Independently design active and passive fire protection systems and prepare Hazardous/H2S Area Classification documentation, safety and firefighting layouts, escape route and lifesaving equipment layout, and other safety drawings.
  • Carry out safety critical elements performance standards, RAM, fire and gas detection mapping, etc., based on project requirements.
  • Act as Package Engineer, if required, for safety and firefighting equipment.
  • Manage and guide Junior/Senior Engineers and Designers on Concept/FEED/Detailed Engineering projects.
  • Provide health and environmental inputs (including health risk assessments such as chemical exposure, noise and lighting, ergonomics/human factors engineering, environmental impact assessments, etc.) to projects.
  • Interface/coordinate with other engineering disciplines and clients, and take the lead in resolving technical matters related to safety aspects.
  • Deliver project safety deliverables as per the project schedule.
  • Provide inputs and support to projects in all safety aspects, including progress reports.
  • Provide advisory support and oversight to the Process Safety Team for their activities and deliverables and ensure technical integrity and quality.
  • Provide support for new bid proposals, including deliverable lists/manhour estimates, etc.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent from an accredited university.
  • Minimum 22 years of relevant design engineering experience, including as a Technical Advisor.
  • Good HSE engineering experience in the oil and gas industry, in process safety/technical safety, with a minimum of 5-7 years in a lead position on similar projects.
  • Involvement in pre- Feed, Feed, Detail design projects for offshore (FPSO/platforms) and onshore (refineries, LNG facilities, storage terminals, etc.).
  • Experience in a minimum number of offshore projects (FPSO/platforms).
  • Good knowledge of oil and gas process facilities, local and international process safety codes and standards, and regulatory/marine codes and standards (MODU, SOLAS, DNV/Lloyds Register).
  • Hands-on experience in plot plan review, HAZID, HAZOP, SIL classification/verification, and other safety reviews (e.g., SIMOPS, ALARP).
  • Good working knowledge of PIPENET Vision, Flaresim, and other consequence modeling software such as DNV PHAST, etc.
  • Ability to influence designs to achieve optimal HSE outcomes.
  • A team player with leadership potential and proactive inter-discipline communication skills.

title: Coordenador de operações
description:
Coordenador de Operações Comerciais (Sales Ops / RevOps) | Lobie


Lobie | Centro - Rio de Janeiro


A Lobie está em plena expansão no mercado de short-term rental no Rio de Janeiro. Nosso desafio atual não é apenas vender, mas garantir a eficiência máxima na implementação. Buscamos um(a) profissional focado em processos e dados para ser o \"dono\" da jornada entre a assinatura do contrato e a geração de receita.


Missão do cargo

Gestão do Pipeline de Ativação:

  • Estruturar e manter o pipeline no ActiveCampaign com estágios claros: Assinado → Documentação → Setup (mobília/chaves) → Fotos/Anúncio → Plataformas → Ativo.
  • Definir e monitorar SLAs por estágio (ex.: máx. 15 dias em “Setup”, máx. 10 dias em “Plataformas”).
  • Configurar automações de alerta: quando um deal estoura o SLA, notificação automática para o vendedor responsável e para o Diretor Comercial.
  • Acompanhar cada unidade individualmente, cobrando as áreas responsáveis (comercial, operacional, tech) para destravar.
  • Manter o CRM como fonte única de verdade: todo contrato entra, todo distrato sai, toda ativação é registrada.


Reconciliação de Dados:

  • Cruzamento semanal entre Extranet (UHs ativas), BD Repasse (UHs com receita) e planilhas comerciais (contratos assinados).
  • Publicação do Report Semanal de Ativação: lista de UHs travadas, com nome do vendedor responsável, dias parado, estágio atual, e próxima ação necessária.
  • Alimentar o Painel de Metas com dados atualizados de taxa de ativação individual por vendedor.
  • Identificar e escalar unidades “órfãs” (vendedor saiu, cliente sem atendimento) em até 24h.


Processos e Handoff:

  • Criar e manter o protocolo de transferência de carteira: quando um vendedor sai, 100% dos seus deals ativos são redistribuídos em 24h.
  • Documentar o processo padrão de ativação ponta a ponta (playbook).
  • Coordenar a interface entre comercial e operacional no momento do handoff pós-assinatura.
  • Propor melhorias de processo com base em dados: identificar os estágios com maior tempo de permanência e atacar as causas-raiz.


Report e Análise:

  • Report mensal para a diretoria: taxa de ativação, tempo médio por estágio, receita potencial não capturada, ranking de vendedores.
  • Análise de coorte: acompanhar a “safra” de contratos assinados em cada mês e seu progresso até ativação.
  • Sugerir ações corretivas baseadas em dados



Perfil Desejado

Indispensável:

  • Experiência com CRM (ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Pipedrive ou similar) — não apenas como usuário, mas configurando pipelines e automações.
  • Excel/Google Sheets avançado: PROCV, tabelas dinâmicas, dashboards.
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a processo.
  • Capacidade de organizar informação caótica em sistema claro.
  • Comunicação assertiva.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar como PJ.


Desejável:

  • Background em operações, CS (Customer Success), ou RevOps de SaaS/proptech/hospitality.
  • Familiaridade com Looker Studio, SQL básico, ou ferramentas de BI.
  • Experiência no mercado imobiliário ou de short-term rental.
  • Capacidade de criar automações simples (Zapier, Make, Apps Script).


Ferramentas:

  • ActiveCampaign (CRM principal — vai ser o sistema-mestre desta função)
  • Extranet Lobie (sistema de gestão de unidades)
  • Google Sheets / Looker Studio (dashboards e reports)
  • WhatsApp Business (comunicação com vendedores e time operacional)
  • BD Repasse (base de dados de receita — CSV/Excel)


Primeiros 90 Dias

Dias 1–30: Imersão e Diagnóstico

Mapear 100% dos contratos assinados e classificar status atual de cada um.

Estruturar o pipeline no ActiveCampaign com estágios e automações básicas.

Publicar o primeiro Report Semanal de Ativação.

Resolver as 10 UHs mais críticas (maior tempo parado + maior receita potencial).


Dias 31–60: Ritmo

Pipeline 100% populado e com atualização diária.

Automações de SLA funcionando: alertas disparando automaticamente.

Protocolo de transferência de carteira documentado e testado.

Reconciliação semanal rodando consistentemente.


Dias 61–90: Resultado

Taxa de ativação subindo visivelmente (meta: +8 pontos percentuais vs. baseline).

Zero unidades “órfãs” no sistema (toda UH tem dono claro).

Report mensal para diretoria no formato definitivo.

Proposta de melhorias de processo baseada nos dados dos primeiros 90 dias.

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

description:

Company Description

AgileHRO is an all-in-one HR, payroll, and mobility platform designed to simplify workforce management for businesses worldwide. Our platform offers efficient solutions for payroll management, onboarding, employee management, and global mobility, with a focus on reducing administrative burdens and ensuring compliance. AgileHRO is trusted globally for its intuitive platform, real-time insights, and exceptional customer support that enable companies to scale effectively. We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Recruiter with deep expertise in the Brazilian Oil & Gas market. You will be responsible for managing the full recruitment lifecycle, focusing on high-level Engineering roles and specialized Offshore positions. The ideal candidate understands the complexity of offshore operations and has a strong network of certified professionals ready for deployment.

  • Languages: Fluent Portuguese and Advanced/Fluent English (mandatory for reporting and global coordination).

Soft Skills

  • Ability to work under pressure and handle tight mobilization deadlines.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills.
  • Organization to manage high-volume technical roles.

Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


*O que você precisa ter

Requisitos mandatórios

• Formação concluída preferencialmente na área de TI;

• Vivências anteriores como desenvolvedor ABAP para SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA;

• Experiência no desenvolvimento de objetos RICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms);

• Vivência em análise e depuração (debugging) de programas ABAP;

• Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de interfaces (IDocs, Proxies, RFCs, Web Services);

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);

description:
About the job

POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position Title: Immigration Attorney (US license is required)

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS


ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • J.D. from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in employment-based immigration law.
  • An active member in good standing with a state Bar, with eligibility to represent clients and sign G-28s.
  • Proficiency in EB1, EB2-NIW, O1, PERM labor certifications, H-1B, L-1, and E visa matters.
  • Fluency in a second language is desirable.
  • Supervisory Responsibility: Yes, including oversight of cases and potential supervision of paralegals and case managers.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Adept at persuasive legal writing and advocacy.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and writing abilities.
  • Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a team.

APPLICATION PROCEDURES

  • Start Date: Immediate.
  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM.
  • Location: Remote.
  • Compensation & Benifits:

-Competitive salary

-Home office allowance

-Health insurance (after probation period)

-Dental plan

-CLT employment contract with full statutory benefits

  • Current clients or family members of employees are not eligible.
  • Email your resume and cover letter in PDF format to , referencing \"Immigration Attorney position”.

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Product Manager Sênior - Planejamento Comercial
description:
Sobre a posição no jogo

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Manager Sênior para liderar a evolução das soluções de Planejamento Comercial , atuando na interseção entre negócio, dados e tecnologia.

Essa posição tem como missão maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos, conectando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado e ao planejamento de compras , garantindo decisões orientadas por dados, menor time-to-market e melhor alocação de capital em estoque.

Você será responsável por transformar dores do time comercial (Buying & Planning) em produtos digitais escaláveis, garantindo adoção real, automação e impacto direto em KPIs críticos do negócio.


Missão da Área

Maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos através da tecnologia, integrando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado, para suportar decisões de compra e sortimento orientadas por dados, com maior agilidade e menor risco.


Objetivos estratégicos do produto

  • Digitalização do ciclo de vida do Produto;
  • Implementar e evoluir a plataforma de PLM, centralizando o desenvolvimento desde o conceito até a ficha técnica final;
  • Inteligência de Compra e Planejamento;
  • Criar ou integrar soluções que automatizem o cálculo de OTB (Open to Buy) e recomendem sortimento ideal por canal, região e perfil de demanda.
  • Conexão com o Mercado;
  • Traduzir tendências, dados de concorrência e sinais de mercado em parâmetros técnicos para o desenvolvimento e planejamento de novos produtos;
  • Eficiência Operacional;
  • Reduzir rupturas, excessos de estoque e markdowns por meio de previsões de demanda, planejamento integrado e automação de processos.


Responsabilidades

  • Definir e liderar a visão e estratégia do produto de Planejamento Comercial , alinhando tecnologia às necessidades do negócio;
  • Gerenciar a evolução contínua das ferramentas de PLM e Planning , garantindo estabilidade, escalabilidade e adoção;
  • Atuar como braço tecnológico do time comercial , conduzindo discovery com compradores, planejadores e áreas correlatas;
  • Traduzir dores de negócio em soluções digitais, processos otimizados e integrações sistêmicas ;
  • Garantir a arquitetura e integridade dos dados de produto , do nascimento no PLM até a venda no PDV e e-commerce;
  • Avaliar e conduzir decisões de Build vs. Buy , considerando custo, tempo, escalabilidade e aderência ao negócio;
  • Priorizar roadmap e backlog com base em impacto em rentabilidade, eficiência operacional e risco de estoque ;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Engenharia, Dados, SAP e fornecedores externos;
  • Garantir que o plano de compras aprovado seja convertido em pedidos automatizados (PO) no SAP , com mínima intervenção manual;
  • Monitorar e comunicar resultados por meio de KPIs claros e orientados a impacto .


Escopo Tecnológico

Você atuará diretamente na evolução e integração dos seguintes pilares:

  • PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)
  • Desenvolvimento de produtos, fornecedores, custos, ciclo de vida e cadastros.
  • Demand Planning & Analytics
  • Modelagem de dados e algoritmos para suporte ao planejamento de compras.
  • Market Intelligence Hub
  • Integração de APIs e dados externos de mercado e concorrência.
  • ERP (SAP – MM / Retail)
  • Integração robusta para automação do ciclo de compra, pedidos e cadastros.
  • Automação do Planejamento para Pedido
  • Conversão de planejamento em Pedidos de Compra (PO) automáticos
  • Sincronização de mestres (materiais e fornecedores)
  • Monitoramento de status de recebimento e notas fiscais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em contextos de varejo, indústria ou operações comerciais complexas ;
  • Conhecimento profundo do ciclo de vida do produto (PLM, Buying, Planning, Supply) ;
  • Experiência atuando com sistemas corporativos e integrações (ex.: ERP, PLM, Planning);
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com uso de dados para tomada de decisão ;
  • Vivência em discovery com áreas não-digitais (ex.: Comercial, Compras, Planejamento);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis ;
  • Comunicação clara, estruturada e habilidade em negociação de prioridades com múltiplos stakeholders .


Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com SAP MM ou SAP Retail ;
  • Conhecimento em OTB (Open to Buy) , planejamento de sortimento e previsão de demanda;
  • Domínio de SQL, Power BI ou ferramentas analíticas similares ;
  • Experiência em decisões de Build vs. Buy e gestão de fornecedores de software;
  • Atuação em ambientes de transformação digital de áreas comerciais .


O que define sucesso nessa posição

  • Redução do lead time do ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos (briefing → venda);
  • Alta taxa de adoção das ferramentas pelo time de Compras e Planejamento;
  • Crescimento do percentual de pedidos automatizados (Zero-Touch PO) ;
  • Melhor aderência ao OTB planejado ;
  • Redução de markdowns e maior venda a preço cheio.


Por que essa vaga é especial?

Porque você vai liderar um produto que atua no coração da decisão comercial da empresa , conectando estratégia, dados e execução.

Aqui, decisões de produto impactam diretamente margem, capital investido em estoque e velocidade de reação ao mercado . É uma posição para quem gosta de complexidade real , influência transversal e impacto mensurável no resultado do negócio.

Bora movimentar o esporte.

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.


The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.


Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.


Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.


Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.


No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.


About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: Comandante A330
description:
O seu sonho é comandar uma carreira de sucesso diretamente da cabine? CheGOL a hora.

Estamos em busca de profissionais para atuarem como Comandante.


Em seu plano de voo, está prevista uma atuação junto ao Time da Diretoria de Operações, alinhada à estratégia da Companhia e aos regulamentos vigentes, contribuindo para a evolução das nossas operações com os mais altos padrões de Segurança e consistência.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Missão do Cargo


Exercer a autoridade de Comandante desde a apresentação para o voo até a entrega da aeronave ao final da viagem, garantindo a Segurança operacional, a conformidade regulatória e a continuidade das operações e representando a empresa perante passageiros, tripulação e autoridades, em alinhamento ao Código Brasileiro de Aeronáutica (CBA) e aos regulamentos vigentes.


Além disso, atuar em integração com os Times da Companhia, contribuindo com sua experiência para o fortalecimento contínuo da operação.


Autoridade


  • Exercer autoridade plena sobre a aeronave, tripulação, passageiros e carga durante toda a operação;
  • Recusar aeronave que não esteja em condições aeronavegáveis;
  • Adiar, suspender ou encerrar o voo quando indispensável à Segurança;
  • Recusar embarque ou determinar desembarque de pessoas que comprometam a Segurança ou a disciplina a bordo;
  • Adotar medidas necessárias à proteção da aeronave, das pessoas e dos bens transportados;
  • Representar o Administrador da empresa durante toda a viagem;
  • Atuar em ocorrências relacionadas a atos ilícitos (AVSEC), mantendo comunicação com os órgãos de controle;
  • Contratar manutenção extraordinária, quando necessário;
  • Validar licenças e certificados, conforme prerrogativa da autoridade aeronáutica.


Segurança Operacional


  • Garantir a Segurança de tripulantes, passageiros e carga do fechamento das portas até o desembarque final;
  • Assegurar as condições de aeronavegabilidade, peso e balanceamento;
  • Certificar-se da correta quantidade de combustível e monitorar seu consumo;
  • Avaliar as condições meteorológicas, NOTAMs e dos aeródromos;
  • Garantir que o voo esteja devidamente despachado junto ao DOV.;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos procedimentos do Programa de Segurança do Operador Aéreo;
  • Reportar condições inseguras aos órgãos de controle e à área de Safety;
  • Identificar e reportar perigos operacionais por meio do sistema oficial da empresa.


Gestão da Tripulação


  • Assegurar a subordinação técnica e disciplinar da tripulação;
  • Delegar atribuições, exceto aquelas relacionadas à Segurança do voo;
  • Definir o Pilot Flying e garantir a execução correta dos checklists;
  • Garantir que apenas atividades essenciais sejam realizadas em fases críticas do voo;
  • Zelar pelo cumprimento da regulamentação profissional, incluindo jornada, repouso e limites operacionais.


Conformidade e Registros


  • Preencher ou assegurar o correto preenchimento do Diário de Bordo e do Relatório Técnico da Aeronave;
  • Registrar ocorrências que demandem inspeção obrigatória, como pouso duro, turbulência severa, tail strike, RTO, incidência de raio e excedentes de limites operacionais;
  • Assegurar os registros de ocorrências a bordo, incluindo eventos médicos, nascimentos e óbitos, conforme regulamentação aplicável;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes de Segurança Operacional (SGSO) e da Política Ambiental.


Cabine e Passageiros


  • Assegurar a transmissão das instruções de Segurança;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de Segurança em situações normais, de emergência e em evacuação;
  • Assegurar a integridade e a Segurança da cabine de comando;
  • Garantir a correta utilização dos equipamentos de emergência.


Não pode faltar em sua bagagem:


Formação


  • Ensino Médio completo (Ensino Superior é um diferencial)
  • Experiência superior na função


Certificações Obrigatórias

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Você será responsável por conduzir relacionamentos estratégicos, conectar problemas de negócio às soluções da Knewin e atuar como principal voz do cliente internamente.

title: Especialista em Chatbot & Conversão — Curadoria, Otimização e Escala (WhatsApp e IA)
description:
Vaga para modelo de contratação PJ


Remoto


A ConCrédito é uma das maiores correspondentes bancárias do Brasil, especializada em crédito consignado nas modalidades CLT, INSS e FGTS. Com mais de 300 mil clientes atendidos via WhatsApp, a ConCrédito preza pelo bom atendimento e pela experiência do cliente, comprovados pelas mais de 21 mil avaliações positivas no Google Meu Negócio.


O Papel

O Especialista em Chatbot & Conversão será responsável por evoluir a jornada conversacional da empresa no WhatsApp, nosso principal canal de aquisição e conversão. Essa pessoa atuará na otimização contínua da experiência, reduzindo atritos, recuperando leads e aumentando a eficiência do funil por meio de automação, testes e uso de IA.



Responsabilidades

  • Mapear, analisar e otimizar a jornada conversacional de ponta a ponta no WhatsApp, identificando gargalos, fricções e oportunidades de melhoria nas micro e macroconversões.
  • Evoluir a arquitetura dos fluxos conversacionais com foco em experiência, engajamento, recuperação e conversão.
  • Rodar testes A/B contínuos em mensagens, copywriting, timing de follow-ups, segmentações e estrutura de fluxo.
  • Criar e gerir réguas de relacionamento, ativação de leads frios, campanhas de reengajamento e estratégias de recuperação.
  • Trabalhar na personalização da jornada a partir de clusters de audiência, comportamento e contexto do cliente.
  • Apoiar a construção de dashboards e análises da jornada em parceria com o time de Dados, garantindo visibilidade dos principais indicadores de performance.
  • Atuar de forma cross-functional com Marketing, Vendas, BI, Operações e Produto/Tech para transformar insights em melhorias concretas na experiência e nos resultados.
  • Contribuir com o uso de IA e automação para escalar conversas com mais eficiência, relevância e capacidade de conversão.


KPIs sob sua gestão

  • Ativação: taxa de ativação de leads recém-chegados ao chatbot.
  • Conversão do funil: eficiência na passagem entre etapas do fluxo conversacional.
  • Taxa de abandono: redução de drop-off em cada estágio da jornada.
  • Time-to-convert: redução do tempo médio para contratação efetiva.
  • Retenção e recompra: aumento do LTV e da frequência de uso dos serviços.
  • ROI de campanhas: retorno sobre campanhas de repescagem e disparos via WhatsApp.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida em Growth, CRO, Lifecycle, CRM, Produto ou áreas correlatas, com foco em conversão e evolução de jornada.
  • Vivência prática com canais conversacionais, especialmente WhatsApp, automação de mensagens e/ou chatbots.
  • Capacidade de mapear funis, identificar gargalos e transformar análise em ação.
  • Repertório em testes A/B, experimentação e otimização contínua de jornada.
  • Capacidade analítica avançada para acompanhar métricas de funil, cohort, LTV, CAC e performance por etapa.
  • Boa visão de experiência do cliente e comportamento em jornadas digitais.
  • Capacidade técnica para utilizar ou estruturar soluções com IA, agentes e automações aplicadas à conversão.
  • Boa comunicação e influência para atuar com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.


Diferenciais valorizados

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs, crédito, cobrança, serviços financeiros ou operações B2C com alto volume de leads.
  • Vivência com desenho de experiências conversacionais e arquitetura de fluxos.
  • Experiência em produto, CX ou gestão de jornadas digitais.
  • Conhecimento em SQL, Supabase, Metabase, Power BI ou ferramentas similares.
  • Familiaridade com IA aplicada à personalização, qualificação e conversão em canais conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em automação com N8N.
  • Experiência com plataformas conversacionais como Blip, ColmeIA ou similares.


Essa vaga NÃO é para você se:

  • Você é mais executor do que estrategista e não tem experiência otimizando funis de conversão.
  • Sua experiência está focada em social media, branding ou marketing de conteúdo.
  • Você trabalha apenas com análise de dados, sem transformar insights em ações práticas.
  • Sua atuação em growth é mais teórica do que prática (cursos, conceitos, pouca execução real).
  • Você nunca lidou com alto volume de leads ou operações em escala.
  • Seu foco é apenas aquisição (tráfego pago) e não conversão ao longo da jornada.
  • Você não tem experiência com chatbots, automação de mensagens ou fluxos conversacionais.
  • Você precisa de direcionamento constante e não tem autonomia para testar, iterar e tomar decisões.

title: Data Architect – Snowflake || Brazil/Remote
description:
Data Architect – Snowflake

Advance hands-on SQL


Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

• Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

title: Customer Success Associate
description:
About AdManage.ai Type: Full-Time We're building the Cursor for ad management.

AdManage.ai helps companies launch ads 10x faster on Meta & TikTok. Created by top performance marketers who've managed over $50M+ in ad spend, our mission is to level the playing field by giving every business access to enterprise-grade ad automation tools.

Our platform launches 900,000+ ads per month, saving advertisers hours with bulk ad creation, creative mining, and AI-powered campaign tools. We're profitable, fast-moving, and backed by experience — not just ideas.


The Mission Our users are ambitious brands and agencies who rely on us not just for software, but for expertise that helps them scale profitably. That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Junior Customer Success Manager with a media buying background who can bridge the gap between software and performance marketing. You'll ensure our customers get real outcomes with AdManage.ai — not just features. You'll be supported by a strong CS team and learn fast.


What You'll Do

  • Support onboarding: help guide new customers from setup to first wins alongside senior team members.
  • Be a go-to resource: use your media buying knowledge to answer questions on campaign structure, creative testing, and platform features.
  • Drive adoption: help customers unlock the full value of features like bulk ad launching, creative mining, and performance dashboards.
  • Build relationships: be a reliable, friendly point of contact for brands, agencies, and growth teams.
  • Close the feedback loop: surface customer pain points to our product and engineering teams. We ship continuously — your insights will hit production fast.
  • Help reduce churn: flag at-risk accounts early and work with the team to find solutions.


What We're Looking For

  • At least 6 months of experience in a customer-facing role (CSM, account management, support, or similar in a SaaS company).
  • Strong communication skills — you're confident on Google Meet, email, and Slack.
  • Comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day workflow, including Claude Code for automating repetitive tasks, drafting customer communications, or building lightweight internal tools.
  • Startup mentality: eager to learn, comfortable with ambiguity, and happy to wear multiple hats.
  • Curiosity, empathy, and a bias for action are non-negotiable.

Bonus Points For

  • Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager or TikTok Ads at a campaign level
  • Any exposure to SaaS tools or ad tech platforms
  • Experience using Claude Code or similar agentic AI tools to automate workflows
  • Prior internship or junior role at a startup or agency
  • Some hands-on experience with paid social (Meta, TikTok) — whether through internships, agency work, freelance, or running your own campaigns.


Why Join Us

  • Join an amazing Customer Success team and grow fast.
  • Direct impact: your feedback shapes our product roadmap from day one.
  • Work alongside founders who've scaled brands like ZOE, Photoroom, and Nextdoor.


How to Apply Send your LinkedIn and 2–3 lines on: What's a performance marketing challenge you've helped solve — or one you're fascinated by? Bonus: any results or campaigns you're proud of, however small.

title: Quality Engineer (QE) — Automação- Sênior
description:
Estamos buscando um profissional com sólida experiência em automação e qualidade de software. Procuramos alguém tecnicamente forte em Playwright, testes de front-end e API, e familiarizado com práticas modernas de QA, como shift-left testing e Gherkin.

O que você irá fazer:

* Desenvolver, executar e manter testes automatizados (foco em APIs e serviços/microserviços).

* Especificar e implementar cenários seguindo BDD com Gherkin.

* Registrar, organizar e rastrear cenários, evidências e resultados no Xray (Gherkin).

* Garantir cobertura e eficácia com técnicas de teste de caixa preta e caixa branca.

* Integrar automação aos pipelines de CI/CD (ex.: Jenkins), garantindo execução recorrente e confiável.

* Apoiar investigação de falhas utilizando observabilidade (traces/métricas/logs), quando necessário.


O que esperamos de você:

* Experiência sólida com Playwright (automação).

* Experiência com Gherkin (BDD) e uso do Xray com Gherkin.

* Profundo entendimento de APIs (validação de payloads, autenticação, contratos, timeouts, retries, etc.).

* Experiência com CI/CD e integração de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins).

* Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados.

* Familiaridade com testes em ambientes distribuídos / microserviços.

* Domínio de técnicas de teste de caixa preta e caixa branca.

* Vivência com smoke testing.

* Programação (principalmente JavaScript) — obrigatório e eliminatório.


Desejável:

* Experiência com validação de fluxos assíncronos e tópicos de mensageria (SQS/DLQ/reprocessamento).

* Noções de Kubernetes/EKS para troubleshooting básico de execuções (logs/health checks).

* Experiência com observabilidade (Dynatrace / OpenTelemetry / Grafana Loki) para diagnóstico e redução de testes instáveis (“flaky tests”).

* Experiência com testes de performance e segurança.

* Conhecimento em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

title: Analista de Segurança do Trabalho III
description:
SOBRE A AXIA ENERGIA


A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.


Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!


ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


• Profissional responsável por planejar, implementar, monitorar e aprimorar os processos corporativos de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho (SST), atuando de forma integrada à governança da organização, com foco na prevenção de incidentes, conformidade legal, fortalecimento da cultura de segurança e melhoria contínua do desempenho em SST.

• Atuar na gestão de ocorrências e incidentes de SST, garantindo o correto registro, investigação, análise de causas, definição, acompanhamento e verificação da eficácia dos planos de ação, conforme diretrizes corporativas e normativos internos.

• Apoiar a gestão de emergências, incluindo a elaboração, revisão, implantação e testes dos Planos de Resposta a Emergências, bem como a interface com áreas internas e partes interessadas.

• Acompanhar a gestão de treinamentos de SST, assegurando o atendimento aos requisitos legais e corporativos, bem como a rastreabilidade e eficácia das capacitações obrigatórias e comportamentais.

• Auxiliar no processo de gestão de EPIs, abrangendo especificação técnica, padronização, controle de entrega, rastreabilidade, inspeção, uso adequado e conformidade com as normas vigentes.

• Realizar a gestão dos requisitos legais aplicáveis à SST, monitorando alterações na legislação, avaliando impactos, promovendo adequações necessárias e assegurando a conformidade legal da organização.

• Elaborar, revisar e manter normativos, procedimentos, instruções de trabalho e diretrizes corporativas de SST, garantindo padronização, clareza, aderência legal e alinhamento à estratégia da empresa.

• Apurar, analisar e consolidar indicadores de desempenho de SST, elaborando relatórios gerenciais e análises críticas para suporte à tomada de decisão e à melhoria contínua.

• Participar de auditorias internas de SST, bem como apoiar auditorias externas, avaliando a aderência aos requisitos legais, normativos internos e boas práticas de gestão.

• Contribuir para o fortalecimento da cultura de segurança, apoiando iniciativas de liderança, campanhas, programas corporativos e ações de conscientização.

• Executar outras atividades correlatas e compatíveis com a função de Analista de SST, conforme diretrizes da área e necessidades da organização.


Requisitos e Qualificações:


• Formação superior, com especialização em Engenharia de Segurança ou Técnico de Segurança;

• Conhecimento sólido em legislação de SST e sistemas de gestão.

• Conhecimento em NRs, e apuração e análise de indicadores de sst.

• Capacidade analítica para avaliação de riscos, indicadores e investigação de incidentes.

• Habilidade para elaboração de documentos técnicos e normativos.

• Comunicação clara e capacidade de atuação transversal com diferentes áreas.

• Organização, senso crítico e foco em melhoria contínua.

  • Notificar clientes sobre atuação em incidentes. 
  • Realizar a abertura de chamados de toda atividade realizada para clientes. 
  • Documentar todas as alterações realizadas em equipamentos como: Troca da senha do usuário de um equipamento, alteração de e-mail, etc.

  • Participar de treinamentos técnicos e processuais internos.

Requisitos:

  • Certificações na área de tecnologia.
  • Inglês fluente.
  • Experiência com suporte técnico (desejável mínimo de 3 anos).

-Firewall.

-Switchs. 

-Protocolos de rede.

  • Conhecimento em cabeamento estruturado:

-Padrões de rede T568A, T568B. 

-Organização de cabeamento. 

-Tipo de cabeamento CAT5e, CAT6 ou Fiber.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Oferecemos soluções sob medida para o mercado, apoiando a atuação em atendimento, gestão, fidelização e meio de pagamento para transformar a mobilidade com segurança, transparência e suporte técnico.


Objetivo do Cargo: Procuramos um(a) Analista Júnior de Red Team / Pentest para integrar nossa equipe de Segurança Ofensiva, atuando nas avaliações técnicas de segurança, testes de intrusão e simulações de ataques avançados. Contribuirá para a identificação de vulnerabilidades, exploração controlada e desenvolvimento de melhorias contínuas nos controles de segurança dos ambientes corporativos.

A posição é ideal para quem já possui experiência inicial e domínio básico das principais ferramentas e metodologias de segurança ofensiva, além de interesse contínuo na evolução das técnicas de ataque e defesa cibernética.


Responsabilidades:

  • Executar testes de intrusão em aplicações web, APIs, redes internas e externas.
  • Conduzir avaliações de vulnerabilidades, análise de riscos técnicos e exploração controlada de falhas.
  • Apoiar e desenvolver atividades de simulação de ataques (Red Team Assessments) utilizando frameworks como MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Preparar relatórios técnicos e executivos, incluindo evidências, impactos e recomendações de mitigação.
  • Automatizar processos e desenvolver scripts para apoio às operações ofensivas.
  • Acompanhar tendências de ameaças, exploits, novas técnicas de ataque e atualizações em ferramentas de segurança.
  • Colaborar com equipes de Blue Team, SOC, Arquitetura e DevSecOps para validação e correção de vulnerabilidades.
  • Participar do desenvolvimento de playbooks, metodologias e padrões internos de pentest e Red Team.


Necessário:

  • Formação completa em Segurança da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciências da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em Pentest, Red Team, Ethical Hacking ou funções equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento prático das principais ferramentas: Nmap, Burp Suite, Metasploit, SQLmap, Wireshark, OWASP ZAP.
  • Conhecimento em ambientes Windows e Linux, permissões, serviços e vetores de ataque comuns.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias: OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK, PTES, NIST SP.
  • Noções de desenvolvimento seguro e pipelines DevSecOps (CI/CD, Git, integração de scanners automatizados).
  • Capacidade de documentação clara, objetiva e orientada a impacto.
  • Boa comunicação, pensamento analítico, capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e compromisso com a excelência.
  • Certificação CompTIA Security+.


Desejável:

  • Participação em CTFs, laboratórios práticos (HTB, TryHackMe, PortSwigger Academy).
  • Certificações como: eJPT, eCPPT, OSCP, PenTest+ e ISO/IEC 27001.
  • Conhecimentos de scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell) ou automação ofensiva.
  • Inglês em nível intermediário.


Informações adicionais

title: Senior Azure Cloud Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact senior Azure Cloud / DevOps role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is greenfield, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is highly selective and security‑conscious. You must operate with strong autonomy, deep hands‑on Azure expertise, and the ability to own cloud architecture end‑to‑end. The expectation is to design, build, operate, and evolve production systems directly.


You will work closely with VP‑level technical stakeholders in an environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential. This position requires someone who can challenge assumptions constructively, explain architectural tradeoffs clearly , and operate effectively in ambiguous, early‑stage environments.


  • Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • 5+ years of hands‑on Azure architecture experience, including subscription and resource group strategies, identity and access control (RBAC, managed identities), and end-to-end ownership of production Azure environments.
  • Strong experience designing and operating Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, NSGs, routing, private endpoints, and firewall concepts.
  • Hands‑on production experience with Azure PaaS services, including Azure App Services, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Front Door, and Azure Storage.
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and AKS operations , including cluster provisioning and upgrades, node pools, scaling strategies, networking integration (CNI, ingress), and workload isolation and security best practices.
  • Production-grade Terraform expertise, including modular design, environment separation, and state management with Azure backends.
  • Strong CI/CD automation experience integrating infrastructure as code and application deployments using Git-based pipelines.
  • Solid reliability engineering experience , including monitoring and alerting design, incident response and recovery, post-incident analysis, and the ability to reason about availability, scalability, cost optimization, and deployment safety.
  • Scripting ability using Bash and Python for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate infrastructure development, incident response, and documentation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to operate confidently with VP-level stakeholders during architectural reviews and operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and own Azure cloud architecture for a greenfield PEG platform , including subscription structure, networking, identity, and environment separation.
  • Build and operate AKS-based workloads and supporting Azure PaaS services , ensuring high availability and operational resilience.
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments, ensuring deployment safety and environment isolation.
  • Operate and evolve Terraform-driven infrastructure, maintaining modular design, clean state management, and consistent IaC practices across environments.
  • Design and maintain monitoring and alerting strategies across platform services, ensuring visibility into availability, performance, and reliability.
  • Lead troubleshooting and resolution of production issues, coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews.
  • Improve platform reliability, automation, and developer experience through proactive runbook creation and operational documentation.
  • Partner with security and engineering stakeholders on network policies, access controls, private connectivity, and compliance requirements.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure, and cost-effective Azure architectures.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently during incidents and architectural reviews with VP-level technical stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years in Azure cloud engineering or DevOps roles, with end-to-end ownership of production environments.
  • Expertise operating Kubernetes/AKS workloads and Azure PaaS services in production contexts.
  • IaC background with Terraform , including environment separation and state management at scale.
  • Use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.


Additional Information

About Us

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Program Coordinator
description:
About Sofia Health

Sofia Health is a fast-growing wellness marketplace connecting clients with top health and wellness professionals. Through live classes, on-demand content, and 1:1 services, we’re making whole-person care more accessible and helping providers build thriving businesses.


Sofia Prime is our flagship wellness membership, offering 300+ live virtual classes every month focused on physical, mental, and emotional well-being—including yoga, meditation, fitness, tai chi, iRest, health coaching, and more.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Virtual Wellness Program Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of our Sofia Prime program. In this role, you’ll help with day-to-day operations, communicate with instructors, support clients, ensure a seamless experience for both sides of the platform, and help expand participation and engagement across the platform.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role ideal for someone passionate about wellness, tech-enabled solutions, and community building.


Responsibilities
  • Coordinate and publish weekly and monthly live class schedules
  • Communicate with wellness instructors to confirm availability, gather class details, and ensure timely updates
  • Provide basic support to clients and instructors (e.g., tech check-ins, live session support, FAQs)
  • Assist with monitoring class attendance and flagging any issues or trends
  • Help gather and organize feedback from members to improve class offerings
  • Collaborate with marketing and community teams to promote upcoming classes
  • Maintain accurate records and help ensure consistent program delivery


Requirements
  • 1–3 years of experience in wellness programming, admin coordination, virtual event management, or community support
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through
  • Comfortable using Zoom, Google Suite, and digital scheduling tools
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Enthusiastic, team-oriented, and passionate about wellness
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Bonus Points
  • Experience working at a health tech or wellness startup
  • Background in virtual wellness delivery or e-learning company
  • Familiarity with wellness programming tools and virtual event logistics

title: Application Support Engineer (DevOPS | Data Product Support | Brazil)
description:
Company Description


Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide. We are committed to excellence, collaboration, and consistently exceeding performance expectations across a wide range of industries.


Mission Description


We are looking for an Application Support Engineer to establish and drive operational support for Data Products within a complex, data-driven environment at world’s leading investment bank as our customer.

You will play a key role in incident management, system stability, and knowledge transfer, while working closely with global teams across the globe. The role combines production support, data analysis, and light development to ensure high availability and performance of critical data services.


What you’ll do


Core Responsibilities

  • Provide L2/L3 application support for Data applications
  • Manage incident resolution and service restoration in production environments
  • Perform log analysis, debugging, and root cause investigations
  • Monitor and support data pipelines and data processing workflows
  • Execute and optimize SQL queries (Snowflake and other DBs)
  • Work with Unix/Linux environments for file, process, and system operations
  • Support AWS-based services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda)
  • Collaborate with global teams during operational hours

Additional Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain runbooks and support documentation
  • Support knowledge transfer activities from vendors or internal teams
  • Contribute to automation and development tasks (Python / Java scripting)
  • Assist in testing and stabilization phases of new product releases

Profile Requirements


Mandatory

  • 3+ years in Application Support / Production Support / Data Support roles
  • Strong SQL skills (Snowflake preferred)
  • Experience with Python or Java (scripting, automation, or support tooling)
  • Solid understanding of incident management (ITIL processes)
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Unix/Linux environments (CLI, file/process management)
  • Log analysis & troubleshooting
  • Good communication skills and fluent English


Nice to have

  • Exposure to ETL pipelines / data integration workflows
  • Experience with AWS cloud services
  • Background in banking or financial sector or financial data / market data environments
  • Familiarity with:
  • Alloy
  • VLF-based query languages / Slang
  • Experience in high-availability environments


What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented environment within a top global institution
  • Flexible working arrangements – fully remote or hybrid options
  • Continuous learning and certification opportunities
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Long-term career prospects with international exposure
  • Inclusive, multicultural team with regular knowledge-sharing and team events

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

Disruptive Talents, a boutique headhunting and strategic recruitment firm, is collaborating with an international Forex brokerage to identify a Business Development Manager (BDM) – Brazil.


At Disruptive Talents, we connect commercially driven talent with high-growth financial services organizations. This is a strategic opportunity to join the commercial growth team at a critical stage of the company’s expansion in Brazil, playing a central role in developing client relationships, strategic partnerships, and long-term revenue growth in the local market.


About the Company


A regulated international Forex brokerage operating across multiple jurisdictions, the company provides trading access and infrastructure solutions to professional traders, institutional clients, introducing brokers (IBs), asset managers, and strategic partners. With a growing global footprint and a strong emphasis on technology, compliance, and scalable brokerage solutions, the firm continues to expand its presence in key regional markets, including Colombia, Mexico and Brazil.


As a Business Development Manager, you will focus on expanding the company’s footprint among professional traders, institutional clients, introducing brokers (IBs), asset managers, and strategic partners.

The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of financial markets, brokerage products, and client trading needs, paired with a consultative, relationship-led sales approach.


What You Will Do:

  • Achieve and exceed individual and team revenue targets.
